_help: Camera thresholds (README: 'Podešavanje pragova'). Starts as the code defaults; edit and save. Read by coach-brain-bridge.sh for every run and by coach-tune.sh (restarts its session on save). Keys starting with _ are comments; any SessionConfig key works (contracts/schemas/SessionConfig.schema.json lists them with defaults and descriptions). Distances in torso lengths (mid-shoulder to mid-hip).

pose._movement: fast hands / moving around: speeds in torso lengths per second (fires above 'high', re-arms below 'clear')
pose._arms: arms crossed: both wrists this far past the body midline (arms_cross), wrist height between min and max (0 = shoulders, 1 = hips), within max_reach of the midline
pose._face: hand at face: nearest wrist closer than max_distance to the nose/eyes/ears; re-arms beyond clear_distance
pose._head: looking down: head pitch (nose below the ear line) this much above the head-up reference (a low percentile over the reference window)
pose._other: posture values are medians over posture_window_s; keypoints below min_confidence_2d are ignored (lower it if wrists vanish when the arms are crossed)

rules._rules: sustain_s = how long the condition must hold before a suggestion; cooldown_s = minimum time before the same rule again
